acyclic_chain: Verifier bytes bind the contract. The supervisor stores the verifier and contract digests and does not store its own digest. The caller stores the supervisor digest.
both_receivers: decode_channel_frame rehydrates the frame and calls validate_received_error_graphs. That walk calls validate_stock_error_graph on every v2 object. Caller, supervisor, and verifier each carry that decoder.
data_files: expectations.json and ordinary-surplus.txt match the Sol079 bytes. That equality is not whole acceptance.
e01_e02: E01 lease and dup2 text and E02 once-publication text match the base outside the new producer. The prior scoped credit is rejoined on that unchanged text.
lower_bound: reserve_lower_bound refuses a non-integer, negative, or over-available debit before the corresponding builder. The exact seal remains canonical JSON length, the v2 validator, and charge_graph.
private_none: The None message is local builder state. Publication commits a frame only after project_owned_error returns through seal_stock_graph. A projection failure returns no frame and does not encode again.
